prefs.language_subtitle: Language of this settings window and the extension
prefs.position_subtitle: Select the position of the Spotify controls in the top bar
prefs.controls_position_subtitle: Select whether the playback controls should appear on the left or right
prefs.volume_subtitle: Toggle the volume control feature using the scroll wheel over the song title
prefs.middle_click_subtitle: Allows toggling the current track with a middle-click on the extension.
prefs.minimize_subtitle: If true, clicking the extension again minimizes Spotify if it is already in the foreground.
prefs.show_controls_subtitle: Toggle the visibility of the playback controls (Previous, Play/Pause, Next)
prefs.show_icon_subtitle: Toggle the visibility of the Spotify logo in the top bar
prefs.show_track_info_subtitle: Toggle the visibility of the Artist and Track information in the top bar
prefs.max_width_subtitle: Limit how wide the extension label can be in the top bar (0 = no limit)
prefs.modes_position_subtitle: Select the side of the track info where the shuffle and loop buttons appear
prefs.reverse_modes_subtitle: Swap the order of the buttons (default: Shuffle, Loop)
prefs.swap_artist_track_subtitle: Show the title before the artist (default: Artist - Track)
prefs.show_shuffle_subtitle: Toggle the visibility of the shuffle button (2 modes: on / off)
prefs.show_loop_subtitle: Toggle the visibility of the loop button (3 modes: off / playlist / track)
prefs.icons_description: All icons used by the extension are plain SVG files in the icons folder (repeat-off, repeat-context, repeat-track, shuffle-on, shuffle-off and spotify). Anyone is welcome to tinker with them and replace them with their own - just keep the file names. Missing or broken icon files can break the extension, so make a backup of the folder first!
prefs.icons_open_subtitle: Open the folder with the extension icons in your file manager
